set -euo pipefail; set -a; . "$HOME/.config/omega/omega-mcp.env"; set +a; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os,urllib.request
body=json.dumps({'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':'github-fallback-e2e','method':'tools/call','params':{'name':'omega_execute','arguments':{'person':'gabriel','command':'printf OMEGA_FALLBACK_PROD_GITHUB_OK','cwd':'/tmp','timeout_seconds':30,'wait_seconds':0,'transport':'github'}}},separators=(',',':')).encode()
req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:8789/mcp',data=body,method='POST',headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+os.environ['OMEGA_MCP_TOKEN'],'Content-Type':'application/json'})
out=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10).read())['result']['structuredContent']
assert out['state']=='PENDING',out
assert out['transport_used']=='github_local_bridge',out
assert out['machine_id']=='ai-core-node' and out['owner']=='gabriel',out
print(json.dumps({'state':out['state'],'transport_used':out['transport_used'],'command_id':out['command_id'],'machine_id':out['machine_id'],'owner':out['owner']},separators=(',',':')))
PY
